base: Use case: stylized-concept. Production illustrated fantasy RPG inventory icon. The attached Hazel grandmother portrait is ONLY the art-style and material reference, never draw the person. Match its hand-painted angular color planes, rich painterly surface detail, confident dark irregular contours, amber upper-left highlights, deep teal-brown shadows, old gold accents, restrained olive green, russet cloth and warm parchment. Charming storybook craftsmanship. Not plastic 3D, not simple vector clipart. Square opaque image: uniform very dark forest-green background #142a24, no checkerboard, no white background, no scene, no text, no letters, no watermark, no decorative frame. A single compact centered emblem/object occupies 78% of square leaving generous empty dark margins; bold silhouette and 3-5 big value masses readable at 64px, do not cram many tiny details. Painted background is intentional.

common.subject: A small corked teal glass potion bottle, golden wing-shaped stopper ornament and a russet neck ribbon. The bright turquoise liquid swirls like wind. One readable bottle silhouette.
A squat heart-shaped red health potion bottle, honey-gold collar, warm pink glowing liquid and two olive leaves tied to its cork. One readable bottle silhouette.
A round violet recall potion flask with a golden curved arrow ornament wrapped around its neck, plum-purple glowing liquid and pale swirling spirit inside. One readable bottle silhouette.
One chunky aged-gold coin tilted in three quarter view, embossed with a bold acorn crest, two smaller stacked coins behind it. Broad warm highlights, no writing.
A cluster of three luminous amethyst violet crystals with pale lavender facets, held by a small aged-gold base. Bold clean silhouette of the precious upgrade resource.
A rich ruby-red faceted heart with a tiny ivory bandage across its lower right corner and one warm ivory glint. Bold clear heart silhouette, no surrounding objects.
A fierce amber hawk eye with dark angular brows, one small sharp golden starburst on the upper right. The eye suggests perfect aim and critical impact.
A worn ivory skull biting a large golden acorn coin, a curled dark purple thorn touching the coin. A magical debt curse emblem, charming storybook not gruesome.
A pale steel shield with one large zigzag crack dividing it, purple smoke seeping from the crack, bronze edges. The shield represents a frailty curse.
A single warm brown adventurer boot held down by a heavy dark iron chain and a small stone weight. Bold clear silhouette of a slowness curse.
A single rough olive-gray rune stone with three connected angular glowing gold grooves, no alphabet or readable writing. Carved worn facets and one sprig of moss.
Two bold curled golden leaf arrows chase each other around a small teal swirl, forming a nearly complete circular refresh symbol. Thick simple arrows, painted engraved metal texture.
An open soft russet leather coin pouch holding several chunky golden acorn coins, one coin tipped forward. Bold readable silhouette that communicates trading.
A stout aged-gold padlock with a heavy closed curved shackle and deep black keyhole, an olive leather faceplate. Thick simple readable locked silhouette.
A large teal-and-gold circular arrow wrapped around a small golden targeting eye. Bold clear auto-targeting symbol, painted brass texture, no letters.
Two thick parallel vertical ivory-and-gold metal bars, the universally readable pause symbol. Equal height and width, separated clearly, hand-painted beveled texture.
Two thick ivory-and-gold metal strokes crossing in an X, the universally readable close symbol. Equal strokes, centered, hand-painted beveled texture.
An old parchment map unfolded in three angular panels, a red dotted winding route between one small mountain drawing and a gold acorn destination marker. No writing. Clear folded paper silhouette.
A simple golden herald's horn facing right with two broad curved ivory sound-wave arcs to its right. Clear sound-on emblem with painted brass and russet leather details.
A proud pale ivory warhorse head in three-quarter profile, dark flowing mane, olive leather bridle with gold fittings and a small russet neck scarf. No rider, no body, bold head silhouette.
A gold targeting reticle with four thick inward-pointing tapered strokes around one small central amber diamond. Simple readable aiming symbol, hand-painted metal texture.
